cards.intuition: Construct the new index as a complete separate generation, validate it, then move the alias in one atomic operation. Rollback is the same move in reverse.
cards.formula: build v_new -> validate -> alias: current -> v_new

cards.intuition: The build reads the lake's silver layer, never the old index, records its snapshot timestamp, and replays later events before swapping.
cards.formula: truth snapshot + replay -> no photocopied errors, no staleness gap

cards.intuition: Model, chunker, quantization, and index build are tagged as one generation, so every metric attributes to exactly one system state.
Structural checks, golden-set comparison, shadow traffic, canary soak: in that order, each with an owner and a threshold.
Old and new indexes should differ somewhat; that is the upgrade. A mass of unexplained change is a stop sign, not a feature.
cards.formula: small explained delta = healthy, mass delta = investigate

cards.intuition: Every gate gets an owner, a threshold, and a recorded result. The cutover meeting confirms green data or stops; it never debates feelings.
Model, chunker, analyzer, quantization changes touch every artifact: full rebuild. A parser bug or new field touches a subset: incremental.
cards.formula: every artifact changes -> full, subset changes -> incremental
cards.topic: Incremental vs Full Backfill Triggers and Idempotent Replay

cards.intuition: Deterministic IDs and upserts make a second run harmless; checkpoints make resume continue, not restart; rate limits keep serving first.
cards.formula: safe to run twice, resumes mid-way, scavenger class
cards.topic: Incremental vs Full Backfill Triggers and Idempotent Replay

cards.intuition: A backfill is done when reconciliation counts match, not when the job exits zero. Finished is a state of the data.
cards.formula: done = count match, not exit code
cards.topic: Incremental vs Full Backfill Triggers and Idempotent Replay

cards.intuition: Alias back to the hot previous generation, invalidate generation-keyed caches, verify against the rolled-back state. Minutes by design, not by luck.
cards.formula: alias back -> invalidate -> verify, in minutes
cards.topic: Rollback Design and Mixed-Version Serving Risks

cards.intuition: Vectors from different models score in different spaces, so generations never mix in one serving unit; dual-run complete generations instead.
cards.formula: model change = parallel generations + alias, never mixed
cards.topic: Rollback Design and Mixed-Version Serving Risks

cards.intuition: Keep the old generation hot until weekly traffic patterns could reveal a regression; after that, rollback becomes a rebuild from truth.
cards.formula: window = regression detection time; past it: hours not seconds
cards.topic: Rollback Design and Mixed-Version Serving Risks
